collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — ROLE MODELS AND GOOD EXAMPLES, RM-41 to RM-90 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more events continuing your "Role Models and Good Examples — 40 Events". Same shape as yours: a SETUP, choices A-D (a few have three), and two possible outcomes per choice; the game picks one outcome from the chosen choice.
collection.description: Two fishers have competed for years over the best fishing spots. One morning, one finds the other's canoe cracked on the rocks.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Two fishers have competed for years over the best fishing spots. One morning, one finds the other's canoe cracked on the rocks.

choices.label: Tell the Rival About a Calm Spot to Fish from Shore.
Leave Them Some Fish from Your Catch.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The rival refuses out of pride but seems touched by the offer.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: Working side by side, they trade stories and a little rivalry fades.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The repair takes most of the day, and both fishers miss the morning tide.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The rival catches enough for supper and nods in thanks.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The fish are accepted without a word, and the rivalry continues as before.

a1__fx.name: Outcome A1
a1__fx.text: The rival fishes from it all day and returns it with a share of the catch.
